back_notes.jsonld.feature-2: "skonfigurowani za Ciebie" ("configured for you") is slightly odd said of agents; "Twoim własnym logowaniu" ("on your own login") is clumsy.
back_notes.chrome.nav.aria-label: "Główne" alone as the aria-label of the navigation is incomplete (just "Main").
back_notes.home.uc.h2-1: "Do czego się go używa" - impersonal "it is used for what".
back_notes.home.use-cases.h3-4: "Tury agenta, które ponownie wykorzystują cache" - "ponownie wykorzystują ... jeszcze raz" is slightly redundant; "cache" left in English and not inflected naturally.
back_notes.home.install.span-1: "wydanie główne" lit. "main release" for what is presumably "stable".
back_notes.home.p-mac.li-3: 'Prywatność i ochrona' (Privacy and Protection) is a non-standard rendering of the macOS setting name (usually 'Prywatność i ochrona' is in fact used; flagged only as slightly stiff). | QA r3 verdict: no issue, «Prywatność i ochrona» is the actual Polish macOS name of Privacy & Security.
back_notes.home.why-stats.h3-1: "Kupione karty GPU: pracują czy czekają?" is clipped/awkward (lit. "Bought GPU cards:").
back_notes.home.why-stats.p-1: "Płaskie wykorzystanie" (lit. "flat usage") is an unnatural rendering of steady utilization.
back_notes.home.why-cache.p-2: 'koligacja' (kinship/affinity) is an unusual, unnatural term for 'affinity'; the English gloss is lost. | QA r3 verdict: no issue, «koligacja» kept deliberately: it is the established Microsoft Polish term for affinity (koligacja sesji, koligacja procesora) and is used consistently across the site; «powinowactwo» is rarer in Polish technical usage and no clearer.
back_notes.home.why-cache.p-3: "ziarno" (lit. grain) for random "seed" is a calque.
back_notes.home.why-cache.figcaption-4: 'To karta, a nie wynik' ('This is a card, not a result') is odd; 'karta' is used both for hardware card and UI panel. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.home.why-cache.p-4: "Wydajność jest nadal wyższa" - "wydajność" for output/throughput is loose.
back_notes.home.why-keys.p-1: "farmie agentów" is a literal calque of "agent farm".
back_notes.home.why-keys.p-2: "Nie ma limitu częstotliwości dla klucza" (lit. "frequency limit") is an odd rendering of "rate limit".
back_notes.home.why-keys.ol-1.aria-label: "drabina priorytetów" is a literal rendering of "priority ladder".
back_notes.home.why-keys.img-1.alt: Contains an untranslated English fragment ('a waiting P9 request always goes before a P8 one') in the middle of Polish text. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.clients.claude-code.req.unknown_model_wi: 'odpowiednio do tego okna' after 'accordingly' is slightly redundant. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.claude-code-router.figcaption-1: "bezpiecznik" (lit. fuse) for circuit breaker is an electrical metaphor; "Rys." for figure fine. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.claude-code-router.figcaption-3: "Nagrano 4 października 2026 r." means "Recorded (as audio/video)"; "nagrano" is odd for a screenshot capture date.
back_notes.agent-tuning.th-2: "Punkt końcowy" (lit. end point) for "Endpoint" is a stilted calque; elsewhere "endpoint" is left in English.
back_notes.gpu-monitoring.p-3: "Właśnie po to się je mierzy" fine, but "pochodzi sprzed przejścia" is slightly stilted.
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.p-1: "balanser" is a loanword; elsewhere "mechanizm równoważenia" is used for the same thing (inconsistent).
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.p-4: "stopni" (lit. degrees/steps) is used for load-test steps; elsewhere "etapy" is used for the same notion (inconsistent).
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.dt-4: "Zarejestrowano" (registered) used for a capture date; elsewhere "Nagrano" (recorded, as audio/video) is used for the same notion - inconsistent and odd for screenshots.
back_notes.cache-aware-routing.figcaption-5: 'To jest karta, a nie wynik' repeats the odd 'card' wording for a panel capture. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.api-keys.p-4: Begins with 'Obsługuje' with no antecedent; 'Claude Code kieruje' is indicative where an imperative seems intended; 'Odwróć poniższy diff, a otrzymasz instrukcję odejścia' is odd. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.features.dd-2: "magazynu plików cookie" (lit. "store of cookie files") is a calque of "cookie jar".
back_notes.features.dt-4: "Bez potrzeby wyjścia na zewnątrz" is clumsy (lit. "without the need of going outside").
back_notes.features.dt-7: "Czat do testów" (lit. "chat for tests") is an unusual name for a playground.
back_notes.faq.a-2: "to, co będzie pierwsze, zależy od opinii" is vague; "w systemie macOS" and "w systemie Linux" repeat "system".
back_notes.faq.a-3: 'Twoi własni agenci' capitalizes 'Twoi' while the rest of the site uses lowercase 'twoje'; inconsistent. | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
back_notes.faq.a-6: "W systemie Linux oficjalnych wersji vLLM ... " lacks a verb (sentence fragment in the answer to "Jakich silników używa?").
back_notes.faq.a-7: "łączy się z zewnątrz" (lit. "connects from outside") is awkwardly phrased: the stack connects out, not in.
back_notes.faq.a-11: Sentence fragment: 'W systemie Linux: hosta z Docker...' (accusative with no governing verb). | QA r3: addressed by fix (see issues).
